verdict.rationale: Lorikeet explicitly supports connecting to ticketing systems, knowledge bases and internal tools to 'ingest data and take action for your customers' (lorikeet-docs-13), and the MCP docs show a live 'get-order-status' tool test with a specific order ID (lorikeet-docs-19), indicating workflows pull real account/order data rather than just static articles. Missing for 10: an explicit case study or independent report showing a live customer conversation resolved using real plan/account history data, and clearer documentation on how account-history-specific integrations work beyond order status.
